request.prompt: Stylised hand-painted game VFX with crisp dark outlines, on a pure black background. A sprite sheet for a video game visual effect: 16 sequential animation frames arranged in a 4 by 4 grid, read left to right then top to bottom, every cell exactly the same size, no borders, no gaps, no numbers, no text. The effect: a ground shockwave seen from slightly above. Frame 1: a small white-hot flash at the centre. Frames 2 to 6: a bright ring of dust and stone chips expands outward as a flattened ellipse, with cracks of orange light in the ground at the centre. Frames 7 to 11: the ring keeps expanding and thins into a dust cloud with tumbling stone fragments. Frames 12 to 16: the dust drifts and fades until the last frame is nearly black. Tan dust, grey stone, orange light and white.
